readmeMarkdown:
# ZSky for Gemini CLI and Antigravity

Create images and short videos with [ZSky](https://zsky.ai) from Gemini CLI or
Google Antigravity. Ask for product photos, a YouTube thumbnail, an ad set in
every social format, or a short clip. The agent plans the shots, generates
them on your ZSky account and shows the results, with links you can open or
download.

## Requirements

- A paid ZSky account: Pro, Max, or a prepaid API balance. Free accounts
  cannot connect. See [zsky.ai/api-mcp](https://zsky.ai/api-mcp) for how
  access works.
- Gemini CLI, or Antigravity (App, CLI or IDE).

This package connects to ZSky's hosted MCP server, `https://mcp.zsky.ai/mcp`.
You sign in to ZSky once in your browser; the agent never sees your ZSky
password. There is no API key to manage.

Generations use your account's included allowance or are billed to your
account at ZSky's live rates. The skills read those rates with `zsky_usage`,
quote the cost before large batches and before every video, and wait for your
yes.

## Install

Gemini CLI:

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/zsky-ai/gemini-extension
```

Antigravity CLI:

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/zsky-ai/gemini-extension
```

## Sign in

- **Gemini CLI:** start `gemini`. When the ZSky server first connects, your
  browser opens ZSky's sign-in. To sign in again later, run `/mcp auth zsky`.
- **Antigravity:** sign in when the browser opens as the ZSky server
  connects. In the Antigravity App, Customizations > Installed lists the
  ZSky server with an Authenticate button.

Disconnect any time at [zsky.ai/connected-apps](https://zsky.ai/connected-apps).

## Commands (Gemini CLI)

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `/zsky:image <idea>` | One image, or a small set |
| `/zsky:thumbnail <topic and headline>` | YouTube thumbnail, cover or social card with a real headline |
| `/zsky:product-photos <product>` | Packshots, lifestyle scenes, flat lays, backdrops for your own cutout |
| `/zsky:ads <offer>` | One ad idea as a matched set of feed, story, pin and banner sizes |
| `/zsky:video <idea>` | A 1 to 10 second clip, or an animated ZSky image |
| `/zsky:usage` | This month's usage, allowance and live prices |

In Antigravity, each skill is also available as a slash command, for example
`/zsky-thumbnails`. You can also just ask in plain words; the skills load on
their own when a request matches.

## Skills

| Skill | Ask for |
|---|---|
| `zsky` | Any image: illustration, concept art, wallpaper, scene. Also usage questions and deleting outputs |
| `zsky-product-photos` | Studio packshots, lifestyle scenes, flat lays, hero banners, seasonal sets, and staged backdrops for your own product cutout |
| `zsky-thumbnails` | YouTube thumbnails, podcast and video covers, blog headers and social cards with a crisp, correctly spelled headline |
| `zsky-ad-creatives` | One ad concept as a matched set for feed, stories, pins, LinkedIn, X and display, with your exact copy |
| `zsky-short-videos` | 1 to 10 second clips, animated ZSky images, b-roll, in fast, quality or cinematic mode |
| `zsky-brand-kit` | Save your brand's colors, fonts, logo and approved copy as a local file, and reuse it across ads, product photos and thumbnails |

## What it can do

| | |
|---|---|
| Text to image | Yes |
| Text to video: fast, quality, cinema | Yes |
| Animate an image ZSky made for you | Yes |
| Animate your own photo | No |
| Edit, restyle or upscale your own photo | No |

## Finishing on your machine

Headlines, logos, exact sizes and product cutouts are added after ZSky returns
the base image, on your machine, with the agent's own tools. This package
ships no scripts. Where the agent cannot edit image files, it says so before
generating and offers the base image with the copy and layout notes instead.

## What is sent where

- **To ZSky** (`mcp.zsky.ai` and `zsky.ai`): your prompts and generation
  settings. Sign-in happens on ZSky in your browser.
- **From ZSky:** links to the finished files, valid for up to 24 hours, and
  inline image previews when available.
- **Stays on your machine:** headline overlays, crops, compositing, contact
  sheets and brand kit files.
- This package has no telemetry of its own. ZSky's handling of your data is
  described in its [privacy policy](https://zsky.ai/privacy).

Every request passes ZSky's content-safety checks. A blocked request is final;
the skills never try to rephrase around it.

## Support

[zsky.ai/contact](https://zsky.ai/contact) or support@zsky.ai.
Terms: [zsky.ai/terms](https://zsky.ai/terms).
Documentation: [zsky.ai/api-docs#mcp-hosted](https://zsky.ai/api-docs#mcp-hosted).

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
latestReleaseNotes:
Initial release of the ZSky plugin for Google Antigravity and Gemini CLI.

- Connects to ZSky's hosted MCP server (`https://mcp.zsky.ai/mcp`) via Streamable HTTP and OAuth (CIMD/DCR).
- Includes 6 skills (`zsky`, `zsky-product-photos`, `zsky-thumbnails`, `zsky-ad-creatives`, `zsky-short-videos`, `zsky-brand-kit`), always-on rules (`rules/GEMINI.md`), and 6 Gemini CLI slash commands (`/zsky:*`).
- Requires a paid ZSky account (Pro, Max, or prepaid API balance).
